name: @acemir/cssom
description: In place of the CSS parser linkedom reads a style element's `sheet` with (pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides): a sheet of no rules. The core's mermaid document (src/mermaidDom.ts) reads a chart's style sheet itself and never asks a style element for its `sheet`; the parser's own build is a script for a page's globals, which the web's bundler cannot import from.
